### Unexpected Justice - Truth For Life - July 8
Author: Alistair Begg
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-july-8-2023.html
Passage: Leviticus 24:19-20
Points:
- The principle of an eye for an eye limits vengeance and ensures punishments fit the offense.
- True justice requires restitution and appropriate consequences rather than unchecked retaliation.
- Humanity's universal longing for justice reflects our design by God as moral creatures.
- Divine justice was fully satisfied on the cross when Jesus bore the penalty for our sin.
- Christians can live humbly and securely knowing Christ took the punishment our wrongdoing deserved.
